notes.title: AntiBots | Winter Update
notes.content:
The winter update is here! 3 new snowy maps have been added to battle it out in, alongside a brand new sneaky power block...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243016/fe75259350b7947390947b0d87a69645887777a4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243016/82181a72c5f5da436dce10cc2d7f6bc7166fa1be.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243016/d71b2144cf748a665cb0186d9cf1e13e0235c58b.png[/img]

Watch out for the new invisibility block in both old and new stages! Shoot this block to create a zone that temporarily hides all players inside. Be careful when using it, as your opponents can hide too...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243016/7140960c830cdb7cd1987721226b722e208c5afa.png[/img]

Have fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243016/9cfdb282918b57ffd754dab4bc4e6a8841f3dff4.png[/img]
